note: Generated assets (lane GEN), routes A and B. Every repository, revision, pattern and lineage claim below was read from Hugging Face metadata at the pinned revision on read_on; no weights file was fetched. TRELLIS-image-large also loads DINOv2 ViT-L/14 with registers through torch.hub from facebookresearch/dinov2 (Apache-2.0 code and weights), which is not a Hugging Face repository and is pinned by its own digest when it is first fetched on the rented machine. Upstream post-processing of both routes (nvdiffrast, a Gaussian rasteriser of the INRIA lineage, pymeshfix, igraph) is not used.

repositories.reason: The pipeline, both flow models and the decoders route A reads: the mesh decoder for shape and the Gaussian decoder for colour. The radiance-field decoder and both encoders are not loaded.
The base geometry pipeline only. The label pipeline is not used, and the texture model is refused: it runs on stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 (openrail++), outside section 6.

lineage.evidence: visual_encoder/config.json names dino_type facebook/dinov2-with-registers-large; the encoder builds that architecture from its config and loads this repository's own weights, whose size differs from the source's, so they are not byte-identical

repositories.reason: Route B's encoder reads only this configuration; its weights come from Step1X-3D's own visual_encoder.
Background removal for both routes: the configuration, the two code files the loader runs and the weights. Replaces RMBG-1.4 and RMBG-2.0, whose licences are non-commercial.
